Assessing connected financial risks

Looking beyond an individual organization to the relationships around it.

The objective

Assess whether network-science technology could help a major bank understand credit exposure across financially connected businesses.

Mak’s contribution

Mak led a viability assessment exploring how relationships between entities could reveal contagion risks, effects of industry disruption and potential sales opportunities.

The outcome

The work assessed a possible approach to managing connected exposures. The CV does not specify deployment results or a quantified reduction in risk.

Source: Makarand Datar’s account.

The experience this brings

Assessing unfamiliar technologies against business needs and examining how relationships across an ecosystem affect opportunity and risk.

Related services

  • Assess opportunities

Linked as transferable experience, not as a Japan–India assignment.
